senses.gloss: m., pl. חַרְצַנִּים (b. h.) a pomace of kernels or shells of grapes; v. זָג.
units: <cite ref="Nazir 38b:4">Ib. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>אכל חרצן</he> if he ate the shell (or the interior) of one berry.
<cite ref="Chullin 82b:13">Ḥull. 82ᵇ</cite> <he>זרע חטה וח׳</he> if he sowed a wheat grain and a kernel; a. fr.—V. <cite ref="C00325"><he>גּוּחַרְקָא</he> II</cite>.
